title: celosia trigyna var. subdensiflora
intro: Celosia trigyna var. subdensiflora, commonly known as Dwarf Celosia, is a plant species belonging to the Amaranthaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine due to its reported health benefits, such as reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Dwarf Celosia include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
